## NEW DIAGNOSTIC: residuals about the reference RAR (descriptive only)
* Median residual: -0.013 dex; mean: -0.026 dex.
* RMS: 0.179 dex; robust sigma (1.4826 MAD): 0.127 dex.
* Median per-point measurement term sigma_V: 0.035 dex.
* Median within-galaxy lag-1 residual autocorrelation: 0.60.
* These numbers describe this data set relative to fixed published parameters. They are **not** estimates of a0, beta or intrinsic scatter; those come from the hierarchical model in later phases. The literature observed scatter (~0.13 dex, McGaugh et al. 2016) used extra point-level cuts not applied here.
